column4: ランス達は平原に多数転がる魔物兵の死体を発見
column5: Rance and his party discover many corpses of monster soldiers scattered across the plains.

column4: 魔物兵か・・みんな寝て居るぞ。よし奇襲して皆殺しに・・
column5: 「Monster soldiers... They're all sleeping. Alright, surprise attack and kill them all...」

column4: 寝ていると思ったが、みんな死んでいた。毒殺されたようです
column5: 「I thought they were sleeping, but they're all dead. Seems they were poisoned.」

column4: 誰がしたんだろう・・
